items.prompt:
A verb's tense shows its:
A) time
B) color
C) length

steps: When it happens. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Within a passage, you should keep verb tense:
A) consistent (unless meaning requires a shift)
B) different every sentence
C) random
items.answer: A) consistent (unless meaning requires a shift)

solution.answer: A) consistent (unless meaning requires a shift)

items.prompt:
'Had' + a past participle forms the:
A) past perfect tense
B) future tense
C) present tense

'Yesterday she ______ to the store and bought milk.'
A) went
B) goes
C) will go

'He opened the door and ______ inside.'
A) walked
B) walks
C) will walk

'By the time we arrived, the show had already ______.'
A) started
B) start
C) starts

steps: 'Had already' = past perfect. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Which keeps tense consistent?
A) 'She studied all night, then she took the exam.'
B) 'She studied all night, then she takes the exam.'
C) 'She studies all night, then she took the exam.'
items.answer: A) 'She studied all night, then she took the exam.'

solution.answer: A) 'She studied all night, then she took the exam.'

items.prompt:
'The explorers reported that they ______ a new species the week before.'
A) had discovered
B) discover
C) will discover

steps: Earlier than the past report = past perfect. Key is A.
